senses.gloss:
उत्फल् उत्-फल् (उद्-फ्˚), cl. 1. P. -फलति,
-लितुम्, to spring; to part asunder, to expand (as a
flower): Caus. P. -फालयति, -यितुम्, to open,
open wide, cause to expand.

उत्-फाल, अस्, m. a jump, a spring, leaping up or
out of, moving or shuffling of feet.
उत्फल उत्-फल, अम्, n. excellent fruit.

उत्-फुल्ल, अस्, आ, अम् (फुल्ल pass. part. of rt.
फल्), widely opened (as the eyes); blown as a
flower; swollen, increased in bulk; sleeping supinely;
(अम्), n. a kind of coitus.
